zero_outcome: EXACT_INPUT_ZERO; no nonzero projected-zero input exists in this family because P is identity
failure_behavior: explicit exception with no numerical success for grammar, unsupported structure, domain, precision, invariant, resource or host allocation failure
cost_model: paid conservative schoolbook bit work and cumulative logical storage, with separate export/replay charges; not CPU/RSS guarantees
scope_exclusions: execution of or identical rounding to the accepted serial recurrence
source expansion into all N literal rows without separately paid work
downstream window/bucket theorem without the companion adapter proof
full sparse recovery or original-input Fourier recovery
